items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I don't know if Byrd was on there, but I know Diz was on it.

ctx.x: Yeah. And so later on Byrd went and got a coffee, and he drank it, you know. And he told us, he say, man, my constitution is getting terrible. This stuff

ain't even phazing me. Well, we didn't even know what had actually happened, but Rubberlegs was already drunk, and he had got ahold to it. He kept saying, this is bitter coffee, man, and, you know. So he got ahold to it, this benzedrine coffee. But we didn't know it.
